 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy

entities.text: Md.Faisal Ali Khanan vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The writ petition is filed seeking following relief:
"......to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus to declare the action of respondent Nos.3 & 4 in harassing and threatening the petitioner by calling to the police station everyday and visiting the house of the petitioner everyday under the guise of case registered against him in Cr.No.825 OF 2019 on the file of the 3rd respondent and even after filing of the charge sheet and facing trial in S.C.No.599 OF 2021 on the file of the Special Sessions Judge for Fast Tracking the cases relating to Atrocities against Women-cum-XIII Metropolitan Se cessions Judge at LB Nagar Ranga Reddy District as illegal arbitrary unconstitutional without following due procedure of law violative of fundamental rights and principles of natural justice and contrary to the Judgment of the Honorable Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar V/s State of Bihar and consequently direct the respondents not to harass the petitioner by calling to the police station and visiting the house of the petitioner without following due procedure ......"

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar V/s State of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. It is stated that the petitioner was arrayed as accused in Crime No.825 of 2019, dated 21.11.2019 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 420 and 376 of IPC and after concluding the investigation in the said crime, the respondents- police have filed charge sheet vide S.C.No.599 of 2021 on the file of the Special Sessions Judge for Fast Tracking the cases relating to Atrocities against Women cum-XIII Metropolitan Sessions Judge, L.B.Nagar.

The grievance of the petitioner is that even after concluding the investigation into the said crime, the respondents- police are frequently summoning him to the police station and confining him hours together in the police station.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner vehemently contended that the respondents-police are not having any power or authority to confine the petitioner in the police station without following due process of law.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 4 submits that for the purpose of investigation in Crime No.825 of 2019, the petitioner was summoned to the police station and after completing the investigation into the said crime, the respondents-police have not summoned the petitioner to the police station.

1 5.

entities.text: Md.Faisal Ali Khanan vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above submissions, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this writ petition directing the respondents-police not to summon the petitioner to the police station, without following due process of law and if the presence of the petitioner is required for the purpose of investigation in any case, the respondents-police are directed to follow due process of law.
6. With the above observations, this writ petition is disposed of.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
C.V. BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 16.02.2024 SUS Md.Faisal Ali Khanan vs The State Of Telangana on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135187851/
